correctness.rationale: Eq. (5) follows by subtracting the classical Green-Ampt cumulative-time formula. Two strict second differences equal lambda*a*D(x) and lambda*a*D(x+1). The Laplace representation makes log D strictly convex, so their ratio strictly decreases from infinity to 1 and globally identifies x. Positivity of F0 is exactly the final feasibility inequality, and explicit reconstruction gives all unknown parameters. A locally free x proves three-level nonidentifiability. Reconstructed equations, boundary signs and model positivity are checked directly; the numerical checker only corroborates.

value.rationale: Four minimal level-crossing times determine two hydraulic and two calibration-origin unknowns exactly; three times cannot. The explicit shape/positivity test rejects physically impossible data without nonlinear multivariate optimization. This directly addresses whether field cumulative-infiltration time series can support unique calibration under unknown event onset and volume baseline. The theorem is a complete natural classification of a canonical physical inverse problem, not merely a forward substitution. Value is structural only, with statistical conditioning and model mismatch outside scope.
